info.title: Laravel
info.description: ERP Tungku API v1. Authentication uses Sanctum SPA session cookies: first GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, then POST /api/v1/auth/login with credentials and X-XSRF-TOKEN. Include cookies and X-XSRF-TOKEN for state-changing requests. No public token issuance endpoint is provided. Amounts are integer IDR; dates use Asia/Jakarta (UTC+07:00), date-only values are calendar dates. Paginated resources return data, links and meta. Validation errors use 422 with message and errors; authentication/authorization use 401/403. A 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds; wait before retrying. Manual payment means cash. Refunds are handled outside this system.
